info.name: CivicFix API
info.description: CivicFix REST API v1. Run `npm run seed` first so the demo accounts exist. Auth uses an httpOnly cookie that Postman's cookie jar keeps between requests. Every POST/PATCH/DELETE must send the X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest header (CSRF guard) - it is preset on every request here. Run the folders in order.

request.description: Creates a citizen and sets the httpOnly auth cookie.
Postman stores the civicfix_token cookie automatically.
To attach an image switch Body to form-data, add the same fields as text and a File field named 'image' (JPEG/PNG/WebP, max 2 MB).

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Streetlight not working near park",
  "description": "The streetlight at the park entrance has been off for five days and the path is dark at night.",
  "category": "Streetlights",
  "priority": "Medium",
  "address": "Park entrance, Lane 4",
  "city": "Lakeview Colony",
  "latitude": 30.9,
  "longitude": 75.85
}

exec: const c = pm.response.json().data.complaint; pm.collectionVariables.set('complaintId', c._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('reference', c.referenceNumber);
const u = pm.response.json().data.users.find(x => x.role === 'citizen'); if (u) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', u._id);
